Claim: Broad-endpoint AUROC is lower under the tested representation and split protocols
Evidence: Broad AUROC was lower than both severe endpoints in 15/15 settings. MaxMin ECFP scaffold-cluster simultaneous intervals: 11-100=0.200 [0.056, 0.345]; 1-100=0.203 [0.059, 0.348].

Claim: The broad-endpoint gap persists with equal training class counts
Evidence: At 125 compounds per class, mean 11-100 AUROC differences were Random 0.126, MaxMin 0.161, Time 0.101. Repeated fits are dependent sensitivity analyses.

Claim: Chemical-use metadata is associated with the benchmark labels
Evidence: Tier versus insecticide status: Cramer V=0.572. Agrochemical-flag severe-endpoint AUROC ranged 0.784-0.909; this does not identify the fraction of structural performance caused by use class.

Claim: Combining structure and metadata improves the saved decomposition point estimates
Verdict: Point estimates with limited interval support
Evidence: Combined AUROC exceeded metadata in 9/9 and structure in 8/9 settings. 0/9 scaffold-cluster simultaneous intervals excluded zero for combined-minus-metadata. These intervals belong to the original decomposition preprocessing.

Claim: Tier2 neighborhood entropy differences persist in some conditional permutations
Evidence: Global: 15/15 within-scheme BH q<0.05; Source×Insecticide: 11/15 within-scheme BH q<0.05; Source×Route×Insecticide: 11/15 within-scheme BH q<0.05. The conditional results do not establish composition-independent universal mixing.

Claim: Corrected scaffold analyses establish a positive Tier2 entropy difference
Evidence: 0/18 saved scaffold-bootstrap intervals had lower bounds above zero. Neighborhood and scaffold-level analyses use different units.

Claim: Novelty is associated with higher Brier loss in selected settings
Evidence: 3/9 unadjusted marginal slope intervals had lower bounds above zero. For the broad endpoint: MaxMin 0.0271 [0.0121, 0.0421]; Time 0.0196 [0.0073, 0.0319]. This is not evidence of a significant slope at every endpoint.
0/12 saved pairwise Holm-adjusted tests had p<0.05. Brier joint-interaction p values: Random 0.883, MaxMin 0.156, Time 0.437. Non-detection does not establish equal slopes.

Claim: Sparse descriptor models characterize split-specific performance
Evidence: Separately selected and fitted Top3 severe-endpoint models had test AUROC ranges Random: 0.696-0.726; MaxMin: 0.588-0.619; Time: 0.427-0.444. This is not transfer of one frozen descriptor signature across time.

Claim: The numerical threshold alone has an identified causal effect
Evidence: Endpoints were derived from joint upstream labels on one dataset. Source, use class, record selection and label processing were not independently randomized; cumulative-label AUROC is not an information-independence test.
